---
title: "Employment Patterns in the US"
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidycensus)
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

> **Guiding Question:** What geographic patterns exist in unemployment rates across the United States?

---

```{r ui, echo=FALSE}
fluidPage(

  fluidRow(
    column(6,
      selectInput("variable", "Select a variable to map",
        choices = c(
          "Unemployment Rate"              = "unemp_rate",
          "Labor Force Participation Rate" = "lfpr",
          "Employment Rate"               = "emp_rate",
          "Not in Labor Force Rate"       = "nilf_rate"
        )
      )
    ),
    column(6,
      sliderInput("year", "Select Year",
        min = 2015, max = 2022, value = 2022, step = 1, sep = "")
    )
  ),

  leafletOutput("map", height = "550px"),

  br(),
  fluidRow(
    column(4, wellPanel(strong("Highest"), textOutput("highest"))),
    column(4, wellPanel(strong("Lowest"),  textOutput("lowest"))),
    column(4, wellPanel(strong("US Median"), textOutput("med")))
  )
)
```

```{r server, echo=FALSE}

# Pull all 4 variables from the same ACS table B23025
get_data <- reactive({

  raw <- get_acs(
    geography = "county",
    variables = c(
      unemployed  = "B23025_005",   # Civilian unemployed
      labor_force = "B23025_002",   # In labor force
      employed    = "B23025_004",   # Civilian employed
      nilf        = "B23025_007",   # Not in labor force
      pop16       = "B23025_001"    # Total population 16+
    ),
    year     = input$year,
    survey   = "acs5",
    geometry = TRUE
  )

  # Pivot to one row per county
  wide <- raw |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols     = c(GEOID, NAME),
      names_from  = variable,
      values_from = estimate
    )

  # Re-attach geometry
  geom <- raw |> select(GEOID) |> group_by(GEOID) |> slice(1) |> ungroup()

  left_join(geom, wide, by = "GEOID") |>
    mutate(
      unemp_rate = round(unemployed / labor_force * 100, 1),
      lfpr       = round(labor_force / pop16 * 100, 1),
      emp_rate   = round(employed    / labor_force * 100, 1),
      nilf_rate  = round(nilf        / pop16 * 100, 1)
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(unemp_rate), labor_force > 0)
})

# Label for the selected variable
var_label <- reactive({
  switch(input$variable,
    unemp_rate = "Unemployment Rate (By Quantile)",
    lfpr       = "Labor Force Participation Rate (By Quantile)",
    emp_rate   = "Employment Rate (By Quantile)",
    nilf_rate  = "Not in Labor Force Rate (By Quantile)"
  )
})

output$map <- renderLeaflet({

  df  <- get_data()
  col <- df[[input$variable]]
  pal <- colorQuantile("YlOrRd", col, n = 5)

  leaflet(df) |>
    addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
    setView(lng = -98.5, lat = 38.5, zoom = 4) |>
    addPolygons(
      fillColor    = ~pal(df[[input$variable]]),
      fillOpacity  = 0.7,
      color        = "white",
      weight       = 0.4,
      highlight    = highlightOptions(weight = 2, fillOpacity = 0.9),
      label        = ~paste0(NAME, ": ", df[[input$variable]], "%"),
      labelOptions = labelOptions(textsize = "13px")
    ) |>
    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      pal      = pal,
      values   = col,
      title    = var_label()
    )
})

output$highest <- renderText({
  df  <- get_data() |> sf::st_drop_geometry()
  top <- df |> slice_max(.data[[input$variable]], n = 1)
  paste0(top$NAME, " — ", top[[input$variable]], "%")
})

output$lowest <- renderText({
  df  <- get_data() |> sf::st_drop_geometry()
  bot <- df |> slice_min(.data[[input$variable]], n = 1)
  paste0(bot$NAME, " — ", bot[[input$variable]], "%")
})

output$med <- renderText({
  paste0(median(get_data()[[input$variable]], na.rm = TRUE), "%")
})
```
